description: This file defines a 'GatewayPushSubscription' enum with static methods for consuming push notifications from a gateway connection, including subscription management and task restarting.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to a stream of GatewayPush notifications, invoking a callback for each push, with support for cancellation and main thread execution.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Cancels an existing task and starts a new one that consumes push notifications.
